name: Chondral Defect of the Knee
definition: Focal articular cartilage damage of the knee, traumatic or degenerative, which may cause pain, swelling and mechanical symptoms.

investigations.principle: MRI evaluates cartilage and subchondral bone; radiographs assess alignment and OA.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Cartilage restoration procedures are selective based on lesion size, age, alignment and symptoms.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-Sandhi structural phenotype may be documented in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Focal articular cartilage damage of the knee, traumatic or degenerative, which may cause pain, swelling and mechanical symptoms.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
